title: prunus domestica var. cerasifera
intro: Prunus domestica var. cerasifera, commonly known as Cherry Plum, is a deciduous tree or shrub species within the Prunus genus. The health benefits of Cherry Plum include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help protect against cardiovascular disease and certain types of cancer. The therapeutic actions of Cherry Plum include its ability to support digestive health, reduce stress and anxiety, and act as a natural laxative. The bioactive constituents of Cherry Plum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are thought to contribute to its medicinal properties.
